test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations collaborated with the Indian Navy for the VLSRSAM launch in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** is India’s premier research and development organization under the **Ministry of Defence**.
 
• It is responsible for designing and developing advanced defence technologies for the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• In collaboration with the Indian Navy, the DRDO developed and successfully tested the **Vertical Launch Short Range Surface-to-Air Missile (VLSRSAM)** in March 2025.
 
• The VLSRSAM is a highly advanced missile system designed to counter aerial threats, including fighter aircraft, helicopters, and UAVs.
 
• This missile is equipped with modern technologies like **active radar homing** and has been specifically tailored for deployment on naval platforms.
 
• The collaboration reflects the synergy between the Indian Navy and DRDO for enhancing India’s indigenous defence capabilities.
 
• DRDO operates through a network of more than 50 laboratories across India, focusing on various defence technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)**__

 __
 
• **HAL** is a government-owned aerospace and defence company headquartered in **Bangalore, India**.
 
• It is primarily involved in the design, development, and production of aircraft, helicopters, and associated systems for military and civilian use.
 
• HAL has played a crucial role in manufacturing aircraft like the **Tejas Light Combat Aircraft** and various other helicopters.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)**__
 __
 
• **BEL** is an Indian state-owned electronics company headquartered in **Bangalore, India**.
 
• It specializes in manufacturing advanced electronic products for the defence sector, including radars, communication systems, and electronic warfare equipment.
 
• BEL collaborates closely with DRDO and other organizations for defence-related technology development.
 
 
 
• **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)**__
 
 
• **BARC** is India’s premier nuclear research facility, headquartered in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• It focuses on nuclear energy, research, and technology, contributing significantly to India’s civilian nuclear program.
 
• BARC is not directly involved in defence missile systems but plays a critical role in nuclear research and development.
